scenes.line1: How do you run many containers easily?
scenes.say: Ever wish you could launch your whole app stack with just one command? Let's see how Docker Compose makes that happen.

scenes.label: YAML
scenes.sub: Define all your services and volumes in one simple YAML file.
scenes.say: Docker Compose uses a YAML file to describe every service your app needs, plus any volumes for data.
First, you write the YAML. Then, start everything with one command. Check logs for any service, and shut it all down when you're done.

scenes.title: Start, log, stop
scenes.say: The up command launches your app. Logs let you follow output for any service. Down stops and removes everything.

scenes.question: Can Compose run across many hosts?
scenes.right: No, Compose runs on one host. For many, use Kubernetes.
scenes.say: Here's the catch: Compose only works on one machine. If you need to run across several, you'll want Kubernetes.
